change_control.review_note: Phase 2 baseline verified against official Japanese government/diplomatic sources.

summary_facts.label: Main purpose
summary_facts.value: Holiday in Japan; work is incidental

summary_facts.label: Application route
summary_facts.value: In person, by appointment, at the responsible Japanese mission

summary_facts.label: UK participation limit
summary_facts.value: Maximum two participations / up to two years in total

summary_facts.label: Funds baseline
summary_facts.value: £2,500, or £1,500 with evidence of a return/onward ticket

eligibility_rules.label: Are you a British citizen?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: This UK route is for British citizens.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you currently resident in the United Kingdom?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Applicants using the UK route must be resident in the UK.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The standard UK Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Employment must be incidental to the holiday rather than the primary purpose.

eligibility_rules.label: Will dependent children accompany you?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Working Holiday eligibility rules do not permit accompanying dependent children.

eligibility_rules.label: Do you hold a valid British passport?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: A valid British passport is required.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the programme's good-health requirement?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The programme includes a good-health eligibility requirement.

jurisdiction.london_label: Embassy of Japan in the UK (London)

document_checklist.title: Valid British passport
document_checklist.description: Original passport; the Embassy checklist states it should have at least two blank pages.

document_checklist.title: Completed visa application form
document_checklist.description: Complete the current official visa application form and follow the mission's signature instructions.

document_checklist.title: Passport photograph
document_checklist.description: Approx. 35mm × 45mm, taken within the last six months.

document_checklist.title: Current CV
document_checklist.description: A current CV covering personal, educational and employment history.

document_checklist.title: Outline of intended activities
document_checklist.description: A realistic proposed itinerary covering the whole intended stay (up to 12 months).

document_checklist.title: Statement / reason for applying
document_checklist.description: Explain why you want a Working Holiday in Japan and what you hope to gain from it.

document_checklist.title: Proof of funds
document_checklist.description: Three months of UK bank statements showing £2,500 cleared funds, or £1,500 plus evidence of a return/onward ticket. Check the official guidance for joint-applicant and source-of-funds details.

preparation_checklist.title: Read the current official guidance
preparation_checklist.description: Open the official sources below immediately before preparing your application.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm your responsible mission
preparation_checklist.description: Your UK place of residence determines London vs Edinburgh.

preparation_checklist.title: Book the appropriate appointment
preparation_checklist.description: Working Holiday applications are submitted in person by appointment.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final source check
preparation_checklist.description: Requirements can change; compare your pack with the current official instructions before submission.
